day_shape: 68 items: Qatar-mediated talks reported rejected by Tehran, US moves Patriot battery to the region and OFAC publishes a fresh SDN designation, UN Security Council splits over snapback status, Pezeshkian cites Khamenei's 'neither war nor peace' order, two charged in UK over RAF Fairford Iran-intelligence case.

threads.label: Qatar mediation and US military posture
threads.summary: Iran International reported a senior Iranian official said Qatar's ideas were unacceptable, while the Jerusalem Post flagged Qatar urging Tehran to show goodwill. The Jerusalem Post also reported the US is moving a Patriot system from Texas to the Middle East as Washington weighs renewed strikes.

threads.label: Tehran four-party summit and regional diplomacy
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi, posted via Defa Press, said the Tehran meeting with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey advanced regional security discussions, while Iran International reported divisions among Iranian commentators and regional demands on Hormuz and nuclear inspectors. Defa Press also carried Houthi official Muhammad Ali al-Houthi disputing Saudi claims the defence minister's visit aimed to reduce tension.

threads.label: Khamenei 'neither war nor peace' messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Pezeshkian told cabinet the government would pursue the Supreme Leader's order to the Supreme National Security Council to exit the 'neither war nor peace' situation. Khamenei's office and affiliated channels also published repeated messages on elites' blood, Iranian 'strength' and Jaan-Feda youth, and Brigadier General Fadavi declared the enemy defeated in confrontation with Iran.

threads.label: UN snapback dispute and OFAC designation
threads.summary: The UN Security Council held a debate in which members contested whether Iran sanctions have snapped back or expired, with the IAEA requesting Tehran clarify outstanding nuclear questions. OFAC published a fresh SDN designation in the Federal Register, and Iran International reported an alleged IRGC Intelligence takeover of Iran's sanctioned oil trade.

threads.label: UK RAF Fairford Iran intelligence case
threads.summary: Two men appeared in a London court charged under the National Security Act over a September incident at RAF Fairford, with prosecutors alleging one sought to assist Iranian intelligence. A separate London prosecution alleged defendants filmed Iran International journalists' addresses to plan attacks.

threads.label: Yemen front and Saudi targets
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Houthi claims of ballistic missile strikes on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and the Defense Ministry, and Yemeni spokesman Yahya Saree, via IRIB, called for Aden airport to be evacuated. Defa Press claimed Yemeni operations have grounded Riyadh flights and hit Saudi economic activity; the FCDO updated Yemen travel advice.

threads.label: Israeli election and Iran-dominated vote
threads.summary: Iran International reported Israeli exit polls pointing to deadlock in an Iran-dominated election, while IRIB cited Al Jazeera reporting Netanyahu's coalition on 56 seats with 59.9% of votes counted. The IDF said soldier turnout reached 79.9%, up 6.2% from 2022.
